narration.text: So the Lord scattered them abroad from thence upon the face of all the earth: and they left off to build the city.
Families picked up their children and walked away, each one toward the few voices they could still understand.
Some went west, toward the sea and the sunset.
Some went east, toward the mountains.
And some followed the great river south into the unknown.
